name: versefnitempreview
description: Preview Fortnite item thumbnails inside your Verse script

versefnitempreview.paksDirectory.description: Directory containing the installed Fortnite pak and IoStore archives.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run publish:backend
scripts.publish:backend: dotnet publish src/backend/Backend.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true --output out/backend/publish
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && node --test out/extension/test/matching.test.js out/extension/test/backendClient.test.js
